Good afternoon, Fernando. This is Ricardo, from Finance. I read your proposal for the family housing pilot, and I have some good news and some questions. The good news: the board likes the idea, and it is likely that they will approve something this year. The questions are about the money. Ten apartments for one year might cost more than one million reais, so the board may approve only three apartments at first. Also, the price of rent in Sao Paulo might go up next year. My advice is simple: start small, measure everything, and assume the worst case in your budget. If the pilot works, the board will be happy to make it bigger in 2027.

Hi Fernando, it's Ana, from the nursing team. I talked to six families this week about the housing pilot. Four families said yes right away. They might come in April, but it depends on the treatment dates. One family is uncertain. The mother has a job in Belem, and she may not be able to stay for a whole month. And one family said no: the father doesn't want to leave his small business. So my view is this: most families will like the program, but a few might not use it. Maybe we can offer them a video follow-up from home. Call me if you have any questions!
